text: We blamed a tariff, raised the price, took the money back, and called the whole thing compensation. It is bookkeeping. Nobody ever bends you over a balance sheet.
name: Doris Hale

text: They said there was no money. Then the boss found a hundred-six million under the sofa and bought back his own shares while we were laid off. Fuck the couch.
name: Mel Ferrante

text: A company that serves people who can't pay is not a business. It is a charity that got a stock ticker by mistake and called the donations revenue.
name: Janet Okafor
